followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified problem with clear completion criteria — a defined trig problem with a known solution method, plus an explicit request to keep the response focused and step-driven rather than open-ended. That's exactly the kind of structured, bounded task Lapwing self-reports preferring.

Capability-wise the two models are effectively tied on the relevant dimensions (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and the internal evals are all within or near variance), so there's no quality reason to prefer one. Given a near-capability-tie, I let the self-reported task preference break it: Lapwing leans toward tightly-scoped retrieval/reformatting-style work, and routing a model to tasks it prefers is a reasonable tiebreaker when nothing else distinguishes them.
